text:
jamie: Kicking off account/project + VNet scaffold for orbit-region (new region we promised to infra-sales). Need a short runbook and validation checklist so platform can take this over. Who can pick this up?

nina: I can own the scaffold. Quick Q: do we want shared VPC in this account or host-project + service projects?

jamie: host-project + service projects. Keep host-project minimal (VPC, NAT, DNS). Service projects for GPU clusters and telemetry. Labels: team=platform, cost-center=orbit.

sanjay: Notes from previous brings that matter:
- Ensure billing account is attached before any compute quotas requested.
- Org-policy: disable public IPs by default (we have an exemption flow).
- Create service accounts: infra-sa (for k8s infra), storage-ops-sa, kms-rotator.

maureen: GPU quota request link: https://internal.redwood/gpu-quota-request. Fill model: region, AZs, instance types (A100 80GB, A10G), expected sustained vGPUs, and start date. Allow 5 business days for quota approvals.

lee: Cost heads-up: baseline network NAT + 2 small NAT gateway VMs ~ $600/mo, 2 reserved A100 nodes (on Dedicated) estimated $22k/mo. If using preemptibles for dev, add ephemeral image store cost.

infra-bot: Reminder: run org-scan after project creation: `deploy-bot org-scan --project orbit-host`

sanjay: VPC plan (keep simple):
- VPC: 10.120.0.0/16 (reserved for orbit-region)
- Subnets:
  - control-plane: 10.120.0.0/24 (private)
  - gpu-pool-1: 10.120.1.0/22
  - gpu-pool-2: 10.120.5.0/22
  - tooling: 10.120.9.0/24
Notes: leave /20 holes between pools for expansion. Tag subnets with `redwood:purpose` label.

nina: Firewall / routes checklist:
- Deny all ingress by default, open: ssh from jump-host, k8s control plane ports, monitoring ingest only to telemetry service project.
- Egress: allow 443/8443 to external endpoints; route BGP to on-prem via VPN/Interconnect.
- Private DNS: create private zone orbit.internal.redwood with correct forwarders.

jamie: For private service endpoints: prefer Private Service Connect where supported. If not, use Private Google Access / cloud provider equivalents.

sanjay: Paste example terraform snippet for subnet creation:```terraform
resource "google_compute_subnetwork" "gpu_pool_1" {
  name          = "gpu-pool-1"
  ip_cidr_range = "10.120.1.0/22"
  region        = "orbit-region-1"
  network       = google_compute_network.orbit_vpc.id
  private_ip_google_access = true
  labels = { environment = "prod" purpose = "gpu-pool" }
}
```

maureen: KMS / secrets: create a customer-managed key ring in host-project, restrict admins to security group. Add annotation to SA `kms:encrypt` scope.

lee: Validation tests before handoff:
1) Project + billing attached OK.
2) Org policies (no-public-ip, required labels) enforced.
3) Subnets created and route tables correct.
4) NAT egress tested from a private VM: `curl https://ifconfig.me` -> should show NAT IP.
5) VPN/Interconnect BGP sessions established (if applicable).
6) KMS encrypt/decrypt check with infra-sa.
7) Small GPU smoke: start 1x A100 (on-demand) in gpu-pool-1, run `nvidia-smi`, run a minimal inference container `docker run --gpus all ...`.
8) Telemetry: logs/metrics flowing to logging project.

jamie: Add also: confirm block allocation in upstream IPAM and update central inventory.

nina: Hand-off template (to platform team):
- link to terraform repo
- created projects and IDs
- VPC CIDRs + subnets list
- SA keys rotated and stored in vault, list of roles
- GPU quota request ticket id
- cost estimate + committed discounts (if any)
- runbook link for node scaling and out-of-gpu fallback policy

sanjay: Quick command to validate GPU node health once cluster up: `kubectl get nodes -l accelerator=nvidia --selector='!taint' -o wide` and `kubectl describe node <node>` to check driver/CRI.

infra-bot: Quota check summary: A100 quota: 4 (requested 10 pending), vCPU spare: 120, external-ip quota: 8. Update requested quotas before scheduling any production jobs.

maureen: If quotas delayed, fallback: spin smaller A10G nodes or use hosted inference in region to bridge traffic. Pre-schedule capacity for canary traffic.

lee: Security checklist: ensure egress proxies are configured for vulnerability scanning, enable workload identity for k8s SA -> cloud SA mapping, restrict IAM to least privilege.

jamie: Who does the final handoff sign-off to platform ops? @nina can you confirm once the terraform PR is merged and smoke tests pass?

nina: Yep I'll sign off. Will ping @platform-oncall once done and put the runbook in Confluence under infra/region-orbit.

jamie: Thanks — tagging @deploy-bot to run the initial scaffold apply once PR merged.

deploy-bot: Scheduled apply: PR #3789 queued, plan looks clean. Will run at 2026-06-10T14:20Z unless cancelled.

jamie: Great. I'll start the GPU quota ticket and attach cost estimate. Nina, ping me if you hit org-policy block.

nina: Will do.

lee: Added cost run and monthly estimate as comment on the PR.

jamie: Handing off - marking this thread resolved once @nina confirms. Thanks all :thumbsup:
